response.query: What harmonization checks, exclusion rules, documentation standards, and governance measures (data security, containers, version control, replication policy) will apply when linking EU-SILC, LIS, SHARE, and national panels?
response.answer: Harmonization checks, exclusion rules, and governance measures for EU-SILC, LIS, SHARE, and national panels include GDPR compliance, data security protocols, and version control for data integrity. Strict exclusion rules ensure data quality, and replication policies maintain consistency across datasets.
